big_picture: This line tests physical-balance and real-time fundamental mechanisms as part of the wider goal of understanding Henry Hub before prediction or model selection.

historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Modern production, consumption, power and LNG balance channels remain unproven by this source and require separate evidence. A separately designed PIT modern physical-balance forecast may still be tested if its source/timing contract is defensible.
historical_facts.observed: rep-012 independently reproduces the Roberts/Brown-Yucel source-period VECM and Table 6 physical controls. Weather deviations are positive/highly significant, storage above its five-year norm is negative/significant, and the controlled Henry Hub residual standard error falls from about 0.081 to 0.077. rep-014 remains an independently reproduced real-time forecasting result with a capacity-held translation. rep-021 then produced narrower historical successor evidence: under a spot-plus-seasonal ridge, adding final-vintage origin-period production/storage/total-consumption improved RMSE by 0.895%, with a three-month MBB 95% CI spanning zero. Post-result acceptance review found that this mapping does not satisfy #348's intended target-matched futures baseline, realized target-period physical-input, and pre-outcome detectability requirements.
historical_facts.rules_out: A stable Brown-Yucel oil-gas cointegrating relation cannot be assumed after 2007; Roberts' full/post-2007 break reproduces. This rules out directly promoting the historical VECM as a modern predictive model.

programme_interpretation: Line 005 has successful rep-012/014 literature reproductions plus rep-021 narrower historical successor evidence. rep-021 is INCONCLUSIVE and C was correctly not scored under its frozen stop rule, but post-result acceptance review found that rep-021 did not implement #348's intended target-matched market/futures baseline, realized target-period physical inputs, or adequate pre-outcome detectability gate. #348's intended mapping therefore remains incompletely answered and Phase 2 remains closed.
revisit_trigger: Revisit empirical execution only after applicable HOLD/REDESIGN blockers are resolved, implementation/power contracts are verified, and the operator explicitly authorizes the transition.
selection_basis: Fresh external-literature mapping under programme 002; no legacy internal result is used as scientific calibration or expected outcome.
tested_role_target_horizon: rep-021 tested a narrower one-month log nominal Henry Hub specification on 212 rolling OOS months using current spot plus seasonal terms versus the same ridge plus final-vintage origin-period physical inputs. A-to-B was INCONCLUSIVE at 0.895% relative RMSE improvement and C was not reached. This is not the complete #348 target-matched diagnostic.
why_zoomed_in: Production, demand, LNG, storage and other fundamentals need source-specific timing and frequency contracts before they can support explanation or forecasting.
